notes: Two actors (customer, driver). Tests actor extraction and that the driver platform is not generalised.
input: Our drivers deliver groceries in same-day slots. We want customers to track their delivery live on a map from the moment the driver leaves the depot, see an ETA that updates, and get a push notification when the driver is 10 minutes away. Drivers use an Android app to mark each stop delivered and take a photo as proof of delivery. If nobody is home, the driver marks it failed with a reason and the customer can pick a new slot.

requirements: live map tracking of the driver
push notification when driver is 10 minutes away
customer picks a new slot after failed delivery
questionsAbout: driver location privacy and when tracking stops
rules or fees for rebooking a slot
